# Marked functions are discovered by ordinary builds, without configs or flags.
[short] skip
go build -o host.exe ./host
exec ./host.exe
stdout 'ordinary before 42'
stdout 'marked first:x:42'
stdout 'marked second:y:42'
stdout 'ordinary after 43'
stdout 'signature preserved'

# The cached build must retain generated invokers and state metadata.
go build -o cached.exe ./host
exec ./cached.exe
stdout 'marked second:y:42'

# The trusted entry wrapper must not be inlined into an instrumented caller.
# Race builds force the handle-bearing environment onto the host heap, making
# an accidental application-side read observable by the ownership diagnostic.
go build -race -gcflags=example.org/isolatefunctiontest/host=-d=isolateheap=2 -o owned-entry.exe ./host
exec ./owned-entry.exe
stdout 'marked first:x:42'
stdout 'marked second:y:42'
stdout 'signature preserved'

# Invalid directives fail during discovery, rather than silently running on host.
! go build ./badgeneric
stderr '//go:isolate requires a concrete, top-level function'
! go build ./badvariadic
stderr '//go:isolate does not support variadic arguments'
! go build ./badplacement
stderr '//go:isolate must immediately precede a function declaration'

-- go.mod --
module example.org/isolatefunctiontest

go 1.26
-- jobs/jobs.go --
package jobs

import (
    "encoding/json"
    "time"
)

var counter = 41

type Request struct { Name string }
type Response struct { Message string; Counter int }

//go:isolate
func Work(request Request, suffix string, delay time.Duration) (Response, error) {
    data, err := json.Marshal(request)
    if err != nil { return Response{}, err }
    if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &request); err != nil { return Response{}, err }
    counter++
    return Response{request.Name + ":" + suffix, counter}, nil
}

//go:isolate
func other() error { return nil }

func PlainCounter() int { counter++; return counter }
func Other() any { return other }
-- host/main.go --
package main

import (
    "encoding/json"
    "fmt"
    "isolate"
    "reflect"
    "time"

    "example.org/isolatefunctiontest/jobs"
)

func run(name, suffix string) {
    handle, ok := isolate.LookupFunction(jobs.Work)
    if !ok { panic("missing marked function") }
    if handle.Name() != "example.org/isolatefunctiontest/jobs.Work" { panic("wrong function name") }
    if handle.Signature() != reflect.TypeOf(jobs.Work) { panic("wrong signature") }
    if instance, err := isolate.New(isolate.Config{Program: handle.ProgramWithHandle(nil)}); err == nil || instance != nil {
        panic("nil dispatcher accepted")
    }
    program := handle.ProgramWithHandle(func(handle isolate.Handle) {
        input, err := isolate.Call(1, nil)
        if err != nil { panic(err) }
        var args []json.RawMessage
        if err := json.Unmarshal(input, &args); err != nil { panic(err) }
        err = handle.Invoke(func(values ...isolate.Value) error {
            if len(values) != len(args) { panic("wrong argument count") }
            for i, value := range values {
                if err := json.Unmarshal(args[i], value.Pointer); err != nil { return err }
            }
            return nil
        }, func(values ...isolate.Value) error {
            output, err := json.Marshal(values[0].Value)
            if err != nil { return err }
            _, err = isolate.Call(2, output)
            return err
        })
        if err != nil { panic(err) }
    })
    instance, err := isolate.New(isolate.Config{Program: program})
    if err != nil { panic(err) }
    if err := instance.Start(); err != nil { panic(err) }
    var command *isolate.Command
    select {
    case command = <-instance.Commands():
    case <-instance.Done(): panic(instance.Wait())
    }
    input, err := json.Marshal([]any{jobs.Request{Name: name}, suffix, time.Second})
    if err != nil { panic(err) }
    command.Reply(input, nil)
    select {
    case command = <-instance.Commands():
    case <-instance.Done(): panic(instance.Wait())
    }
    var result jobs.Response
    if err := json.Unmarshal(command.Payload, &result); err != nil { panic(err) }
    fmt.Printf("marked %s:%d\n", result.Message, result.Counter)
    command.Reply(nil, nil)
    if err := instance.Wait(); err != nil { panic(err) }
}

func main() {
    if _, ok := isolate.LookupFunction(jobs.PlainCounter); ok { panic("unmarked function received isolate handle") }
    if _, ok := isolate.LookupFunction(jobs.Other()); !ok { panic("private marked function not discovered") }
    fmt.Println("ordinary before", jobs.PlainCounter())
    run("first", "x")
    run("second", "y")
    fmt.Println("ordinary after", jobs.PlainCounter())
    fmt.Println("signature preserved")
}
-- badgeneric/main.go --
package main
//go:isolate
func Bad[T any](arg T) error { return nil }
func main() {}
-- badvariadic/main.go --
package main
//go:isolate
func Bad(args ...string) error { return nil }
func main() {}
-- badplacement/main.go --
package main
//go:isolate
var Bad = 1
func main() {}
